title: Mandarin phoneme inventory expansion in measured-marginal batches
hypothesis: Adding final units one acoustically-defined batch at a time (stage 1: e, ian, ing, iou as single units with full formant trajectories) raises measured syllable coverage on the AISHELL-3 v3 manifest monotonically and never makes an invalid syllable renderable, while leaving every already-supported phoneme's rendering byte-identical; utterance coverage stays far below syllable coverage because a sentence needs every syllable.

command: python experiments/EXP-0016/probe_coverage.py --manifest /Volumes/LingXiWorkspace/VHE-Datasets/derived/aishell3-scan/v3/manifest.jsonl --stage 1 --out experiments/EXP-0016/logs/coverage_stage1.json && python experiments/EXP-0016/probe_phonemes.py --stage 1 --units e ian ing iou --json experiments/EXP-0016/logs/phonemes_stage1_v2.json --wav-dir experiments/EXP-0016/artifacts/stage1
notes: Stage 1 (e, ian, ing, iou) accepted: syllable coverage 0.309544 -> 0.503755, utterance coverage 0.002124 -> 0.012279 (187 -> 1081 of 88035). The 8 stage-0 regression renders are byte-identical after the inventory grew (logs/phonemes_stage1_v2.json, regression.all_same=true). Two measurement designs were discarded before the final harmonic-peak probe (logs/phonemes_stage1_v1.json keeps a label defect). No listening test; utterance coverage is still 1.2%.
